numerical_recomputation.notes: All printed generations, assignments, movement, coverage, balance, checkpoints, and fencing comparisons reproduce under the repository snippet verifier.

evidence: Verified assignment is a partition-to-member function and exclusive complete active coverage requires exactly one current owner per eligible partition.
Verified cooperative movement is the set of partitions whose old and new owners differ, while eager protocols can revoke unaffected ownership too.
Verified count balance is not weighted capacity balance and one hot partition remains indivisible under exclusive assignment.
Verified recovery duration composes detection, assignment, restore, and catch-up rather than equating session timeout with recovery.
Verified an increasing generation is useful for fencing only when ownership-sensitive state/effect boundaries enforce it.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Equations are coordination/capacity models under complete membership/topology and stable measurement assumptions, not proofs of any deployed coordinator or sink.
